desc:
🌀 Grab the bar, SPIN as fast as you can and FLY across the map!

💪 Train your Strength on AFK pads and unlock powerful Arms to fly even farther.
🌍 Explore 3 worlds: Green Valley, Shipwreck Cove and Cosmic Frontier.
🥚 Hatch eggs and equip pets that boost your power.
✨ Rare throws trigger epic cutscenes: Lucky, Secret and Mythic!
🔁 Rebirth for permanent multipliers and climb the leaderboards.
🎁 Daily rewards, playtime gifts, trails and codes.

Play with friends for bonus Cash!
